# ui::PrintHost

Header: `winui/ui/Printing.hpp`.

What [print()](#print) hands the job to: the platform's print dialog and spooler, or a test double ([ui::testing::TestPrintHost](../testing/test-print-host.md)).

## ~PrintHost

```cpp
virtual ~PrintHost() = default
```

## print

```cpp
virtual PrintResult print(const Window* owner, PrintJob& job) = 0
```

Runs `job` over `owner` (nullptr: none) and says how it ended.
